name: Enda Mariam Orthodox Cathedral (St Mary's)
subtitle: The main Eritrean Orthodox cathedral in Asmara, built in 1938 in a modernist idiom that draws on highland building traditions.

facts.label: Technique
facts.value: Wooden dowels binding the walls, a long-standing highland method

facts.label: Setting
facts.value: Native church of Arbate Asmara in the mixed zone around the market

parts.text: The main Eritrean Orthodox cathedral in Asmara, built in 1938 in a modernist idiom that draws on highland building traditions. It stands in the former mixed zone of the Italian-era city, which falls inside the UNESCO-inscribed historic centre (inference from the nomination paper: the paper places the nominated property as the Italian-era centre and describes St Mary's in the mixed zone).
